marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 20 knots this evening then
diminishing to light Wednesday evening. Scattered flurries. Fog patches dissipating early this
evening. Temperatures minus 3 falling to minus 9
overnight. Over open water freezing spray beginning after midnight and
ending Wednesday evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
Wednesday morning then subsiding to 1 or less Wednesday evening.<br/>
